usedFor: Mollie holds payments and customers, and Calendly receives a booking link from “Create Scheduling Link” after “New Payment”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Payment” in Mollie, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A paying customer can be offered a booking link, so delivery or onboarding calls get scheduled.

watchOut: “New Payment” in Mollie is polling, so the booking link is created after a scheduled check.
